description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function that compiles the 'default' modifier which assigns a default value to variables if they are empty. It defines a function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_default' that generates PHP code for this purpose.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_default
methods.description: Generates PHP code to assign default values for variables if they are empty, used as a Smarty plugin modifier.
